title: Bonnet's sparse twin-width 3 conjecture for bounded tree-width
statement: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a class of graphs of twin-width at most $3$, and suppose there exists an integer $t$ such that no graph $G\in\mathcal{C}$ contains $K_{t,t}$ as a subgraph. **Sparse twin-width 3 conjecture.** Then $\mathcal{C}$ has bounded tree-width. This conjecture relates sparse graph classes of bounded twin-width to the structural theory of bounded tree-width; the paper proves the analogous statement for twin-width at most $2$, while the case of twin-width $3$ is presented as the motivating open problem.
source_name: Benjamin Bergougnoux, Jakub Gajarský, Grzegorz Guśpiel, Petr Hliněný, Filip Pokrývka and Marek Sokołowski, “Sparse Graphs of Twin-width 2 Have Bounded Tree-width”, arXiv:2307.01732 (2023).
